summary: @ornikar/graphql-config preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling bundle
details: The package's package.json declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that runs automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs is obfuscated (hex-named identifiers, string-map indirection) and downloads the Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts it to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a locally shipped `math_init.js` (~727KB). math_init.js is a heavily obfuscated Bun-CJS bundle (rotated string-array constant table via a `WV8StW` rotation function, hex/opaque identifiers) unrelated to the advertised graphql-config purpose. Staging the payload for execution by a freshly downloaded alternate language runtime evades Node-based scanning of the install path. The scope `@ornikar` combined with the dropper shape is consistent with a typosquat/impersonation of a legitimate organization's graphql-config helper.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
